ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_PaczkaTowary' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_PaczkaTowary;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_PaczkaTowary] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int, @packageSize int, @packageNumber int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @maskaDostawca INT = 8, @maskaOdbiorca INT = 16
select Twr_GIDNumer as [@Id], twr_kod as [@Code], twr_nazwa as [@Name], 1 as [@NameVersion], isnull(TwO_Opis,'') as [@Description], --MOŻE BYĆ WIELE OPISÓW, brać pierwszy z brzegu? case when Twr_Typ=4 then 2 when Twr_Typ=2 then 1 else Twr_Typ end as [@Type], 'true' as [@DiscountOnPrice], --Co tutaj? isnull(Naz_GIDLp,0) as [@VATRateId], (select naz_gidlp from cdn.Nazwy where Naz_Nazwa = Twr_Jm AND naz_gidtyp=144) as [@BasicUnitId], case when Twr_Waga <> 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsWeighedProduct], -- as [@RetrieveSetElements], -- as [@CategoryId], case when Twr_Archiwalny = 1 THEN 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsActive], -- as [@VoucherSortId], 'false' as [@CollectVATOnASI], 'false' as [@IsRepurchase], 'true' as [@DiscountAllowed], -- as [@AllowSetModification], 'false' as [@CanEditName], 'false' as [@CanUseReverseCharge], twr_kod as [@FiscalName], (SELECT (select Twr_GIDNumer as [@ProductId], 1 as [@NameVersion], Twr_Nazwa as [@Name] for xml path('Name'),type) for xml path('Names'),type), (SELECT ( select * from (select -twr_gidnumer as [@Id], --Twr_GIDNumer as [@ProductId], naz_gidlp as [@UnitId], case when Twr_JMCalkowita = 1 then 0 else coalesce(Twr_JmFormat,0) end as [@Precision], 1 as [@Numerator], 1 as [@Denominator], 'false' as [@DecimalRepresentation], 0.0000 as [@Volume], 1 as [@VolumeUnitId], 0 as [@GrossWeight], 0 as [@NetWeight], 1 as [@WeightUnitId], 'true' as [@IsActive] from cdn.Nazwy where Naz_Nazwa = Twr_Jm and naz_gidtyp=144 and not exists(select * from CDN.TwrJm where TwJ_JmZ=Twr_Jm AND twj_twrnumer=twr_gidnumer) union all
select distinct Twj_Id /*case when Naz_Nazwa=Twr_Jm then 1 else twj_twrlp+1 end*/ as [@Id], --Twr_GIDNumer as [@ProductId], naz_gidlp as [@UnitId], case when TwJ_Calkowita = 1 then 0 else TwJ_JmFormat end as [@Precision], ISNULL(TwJ_PrzeliczL,1) as [@Numerator], ISNULL(TwJ_PrzeliczM,1) as [@Denominator], 'false' as [@DecimalRepresentation], 0.0000 as [@Volume], 1 as [@VolumeUnitId], ISNULL(TwJ_WagaBrutto,Twr_WagaBrutto) as [@GrossWeight], ISNULL(TwJ_Waga,Twr_Waga) as [@NetWeight], 1 as [@WeightUnitId], 'true' as [@IsActive] from cdn.TwrJm right join cdn.Nazwy on Naz_Nazwa = TwJ_JmZ where naz_gidtyp=144 AND(TwJ_TwrNumer = Twr_GIDNumer)-- OR Naz_Nazwa=Twr_Jm) ) c
for xml path('Unit'),type) for xml path('Units'),type) from cdn.POS_TwrDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,@rowVersion) join cdn.twrkarty on Twr_GIDNumer = TwrGidNumer left join cdn.TwrOpisy on Twr_GIDNumer=TwO_TwrNumer AND TwO_Jezyk = 0 left join cdn.Nazwy on naz_gidtyp=624 and Naz_Nazwa = Twr_GrupaPodSpr+' '+cast(Twr_StawkaPodSpr as nvarchar) where TwrLP between (@packageNumber-1)*@packageSize+1 and @packageNumber*@packageSize for xml path('Product') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_PaczkaTowary TO CDNRaport
